article.title: We beat the Trump administration in court. Now we’re going to the ICC to hold the U.S. accountable for the Gaza genocide
article.author: Tariq Ra’ouf
article.content: A recent lawsuit successfully challenged the Trump administration's assault on the International Criminal Court. Now, families like mine, whose relatives have been killed with U.S.-supplied weapons in Gaza, might finally have a chance at justice.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
